trText.balle-rouge: Red lipstick is her fame, / Setting hearts to flame. / Screaming / “My name is trouble!” Like her tyranny’s on fire.
trText.one-night-only: Like a perfect pitch, pillows on top of each. / A black leather dark room, with a wondrous moan. / A ritual-like night and day, an irresistible game. / “I don’t want to know your name.” is his fame.
trText.a-wondrous-flight: Infatuation’s dance, / An enchanting trance. / You are my sun, / Ever shining, ever light. / Enchanted by you, / Our souls take flight.
trText.passion-island: In a realm of golden sands and sea, / Passion Island sets you free. / A place where dreams and desires ignite, / In a glow so soft, so light. / Exotic scents in breezes chanted, / Whispers promise, “Your wish is granted.” / Reality fades, desire’s command, / In this paradise, where fantasies expand.
trText.amberique: …and she knew she was a thing, / like he knew he was a king. / a tiger today, / filling the room with her roar… / a pleaser yesterday, / moaning / “you’re gonna fall in love soon.”…
trText.oud-hypnotique: Touch me with your power, / Caress me with your mind. / Surrendered to an old spell, / I seek no escape.
trText.crumble-me-softly: Sweet enough to tempt, strong enough to last. / Such a sweet conquest… / A bite in the dark, baked to tease. / “Oh, that aftertaste!” / I want more..
trText.tobacco-flirting-with-vanilla: “Talk smoky to me!” she said, / his tobacco lips / and her vanilla soul / blending into each other…
trText.out-of-reach: We sailed without a plan. / Just you, me & the sea. / Ice in our drinks, salt on the lip, / A frozen dream upon a golden ship. / No drama promised, no maps to reach, / Far from the world, / Far from the beach. / A cold sweetness that never ends— / Where the azure begins, / And the story melts.
